records.title: SBI official release confirms SMBC Group 5% capital participation in SBI Startale Marketing
records.purpose: Jointly study new financial services using stablecoins, including JPYSC
records.correction: Primary SBI release explicitly states the 5% participation, superseding the earlier secondary-only classification.

records.title: SBI and Startale join Open Standard and explore JPYSC/OUSD interoperability
records.participants: More than 140 organizations including Visa, Stripe, Mastercard, BlackRock and Coinbase
records.status: Interoperability proof-of-concept under consideration; not live
records.note: Coinbase's membership in the wider Open Standard is an indirect consortium overlap, not proof of a direct Coinbase-JPYSC commercial contract.

records.title: Secondary report of JPYSC outstanding issuance at approximately JPY20.8B on October 30
records.note: Do not replace SBI's official September 7 JPY20.1B figure without an issuer filing or reserve report.
